newsitem.title: USA: BHC forms committe to evaluate PCM letter.
newsitem.headline: BHC forms committe to evaluate PCM letter.

text.p: BHC Financial Inc said on Thursday that its board of directors formed a special committee of independent directors to evaluate a merger offer from Private Capital Management affiliates and that it would respond in due course.

In a filing on Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange commission, a group led by Private Capital said it offered to put together a deal to acquire all BHC Financial outstanding stock for cash.
Private Capital holds a 17.07 percent stake in BHC or 1.1 million common shares.
BHC Financial also said one of its large clients, USAA Brokerage Services, intended to internalize its brokerage opeartions in the second half of 1997.

BHC is a third-party provider of integrated processing and support services to securities brokerage affiliates of banks, broker dealers and other financial institutions and USAA represented about 9 percent of its total 1995 revenues.
USAA told BHC of its plans because of the Private Capital letter and because it was an investor in BHC, the company said.
